search_text: published ZDI-25-740 ZDI-CAN-25641 (Pwn2Own) QNAP QHora-322 backup Use of Hard-coded Cryptographic Key Privilege Escalation Vulnerability 2025-07-31 8.0 AV:A/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['QNAP'] ['QHora-322'] This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to bypass authentication on affected installations of QNAP QHora-322 routers. title: (Pwn2Own) QNAP QHora-322 backup Use of Hard-coded Cryptographic Key Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to bypass authentication on affected installations of QNAP QHora-322 routers. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the Backup and Restore functionality. The issue results from the use of a hardcoded cryptographic key. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code in the context of root.
